name: aaron-marketing-skills
description: A comprehensive single-contract framework providing 120 marketing skills and 8 command modules for Claude Code & AI agents, spanning 7 marketing disciplines with integrated 8 auditor gates to ensure quality, effectiveness, and compliance.

inputs.name: marketing_task
inputs.description: Description or identifier of the marketing task or goal to be performed.

inputs.name: discipline
inputs.description: Specifies one of the seven marketing disciplines: SEO/GEO, influencer, paid ads, email, product launch, organic social, or brand narrative.

inputs.name: command
inputs.description: One of the 8 command types used to direct AI behavior or agent operations.

inputs.name: content_input
inputs.description: Marketing content or data that will be processed or evaluated.

inputs.name: auditor_gate
inputs.description: One of the 8 quality/audit gates (CORE-EEAT, CITE, STAR, ROAS, SEND, RAMP, ECHO, TALE) for validating outputs.

outputs.name: skill_execution_result
outputs.description: The outcome or generated marketing solution from applying a selected marketing skill or command.

outputs.name: audit_report
outputs.description: Detailed feedback and scoring based on one or more auditor gates evaluating the marketing output quality.

patterns: Unified skill contract integrating multi-disciplinary marketing capabilities
Modular command interface for AI agents
Multi-gate auditor framework for quality assurance and compliance
Shared contract to facilitate interoperability between marketing AI agents
Scored performance validation through distinct auditor gates
steps: Input marketing task description and select relevant marketing discipline
Invoke one or more of the 120 marketing skills or 8 command modules aligned to the task
AI agent processes input and generates marketing content or solution
Apply the 8 auditor gates to review and validate the output for quality, effectiveness, and compliance
Receive audit reports and refine the output based on gate feedback
Deploy or utilize the validated marketing solution
use_cases: Creating SEO-optimized content tailored to geographic and topical contexts
Managing influencer marketing campaigns using data-driven skills
Generating and optimizing paid advertisements for ROI maximization
Crafting email marketing sequences with compliance and engagement in mind
Planning and executing product launch strategies using integrated AI capabilities
Developing organic social media content to build brand presence
Shaping consistent brand narrative content across multiple channels
Conducting automated quality audits on marketing outputs to ensure trust and regulatory compliance

prompt_templates.name: execute_marketing_skill
prompt_templates.template: Perform the marketing task: {marketing_task} using discipline: {discipline} with command: {command} on content: {content_input}.

prompt_templates.name: audit_marketing_output
prompt_templates.template: Evaluate the following marketing output using auditor gate: {auditor_gate}: {content_input}.

prompt_templates.name: generate_marketing_campaign
prompt_templates.template: Create a comprehensive marketing campaign focusing on {discipline} incorporating skills from the shared contract.
